Single_ReAct_Agent.tradeoff_notes: Single ReAct agent hallucinates tool calls when given 12+ tools simultaneously, leading to high token burn.

Prebuilt_Supervisor.tradeoff_notes: Supervisor introduces conversational routing overhead and occasional routing loops between writer and critic.

GigBid_HandBuilt_StateGraph.tradeoff_notes: Hand-built graph with parallel branches (Analyst/Risk/Matcher) and bounded loops executes deterministically with lowest cost.
